strategy.name: RV mean-reversion + cost gate (Phase-2 idea, intraday)
strategy.desc: Estimate each crude spread's fair value as a rolling mean of its own recent history; fade a >=2sigma dislocation ONLY when the expected $ move to fair clears 2x realistic cost (volatility-adaptive cost gate); ride the reversion through fair to ~1sigma overshoot (z<=-1.0), with a 3.5sigma stop, a 12h time stop, or a session break. Universe pruned to the 3 structures with a persistent post-cost edge. Fixed 1 unit/trade, gross.
